checks.question: UGC present → is there a real report/block/moderation UI flow, not just keywords in copy?
Health/medical/wellness claims in metadata or UI without appropriate disclaimers or HealthKit compliance?
Metadata/marketing claims match implemented features (AI, offline, ad-block, sync, etc.)?
Login-gated app → App Review demo account / notes **actionable** (credentials, steps, not placeholder)?
Store-facing copy or UI still says beta / test / preview / work-in-progress?
Primary category plausible for app type (game vs utility vs health, etc.)?
App preview assets present → features shown match the shipped app and metadata?
Screenshots show features the app actually ships; no misleading device frames or competitor UI?
Pricing/subscription language in metadata matches paywall (free vs paid, trial terms)?
Incentivized review copy ("rate 5 stars", "review for reward") in metadata or UI?
Cross-locale metadata consistent (feature lists, trial terms, support/privacy URLs, pricing claims)?
Digital goods sold or unlocked via external purchase links (web checkout, Stripe in WebView)?
Subscription/trial/auto-renew/cancel disclosures are **legible sentences**, not keyword stubs?
App is more than a thin shell: meaningful navigation, native affordances, not a lone WebView brochure?
Push or HomeKit entitlement → used as intended (no spam-push promises; HomeKit without home UI)?
Third-party login present → Sign in with Apple offered, or a documented exempt case (enterprise, existing account, etc.)?
Privacy policy text (fetched) matches data collection in code, PrivacyInfo, and App Privacy narrative?
Purpose strings are specific and tied to a visible feature (not empty, generic, or copy-paste)?
Data/permission requests proportionate to stated app purpose (no obvious over-collection)?
Permission denial handled gracefully — no infinite re-prompt loops or hard blocks without explanation?
Custom pre-permission priming screens use neutral CTA copy ("Continue"/"Next") — no steering toward Allow/Grant/Enable?
ATT prompt, `NSUserTrackingUsageDescription`, privacy policy tracking section, and ad SDK usage align?
HealthKit data not used for advertising/marketing; sync paths respect health-data rules?
Kids-audience signals → parental gate before external links/purchases/account areas?
VPN/NetworkExtension → on-screen disclosure text visible in UI strings (not only Info.plist)?
Obvious third-party trademark/brand misuse in metadata, assets, or UI copy?
Contest/sweepstakes/lottery copy → official rules/eligibility/disclosure present in metadata?
Developer identity consistent: app name, support URL content, bundle/marketing domain match?
Rating/review manipulation dark patterns (withhold features until 5 stars, direct write-review links without `requestReview`)?
In a category Apple names as saturated (4.3(b)), is the app meaningfully different from the incumbents, and free of 4.3(a) per-variant bundle ids?
Would the app pass Apple's minimum design bar: usable iPad / large-text layout, no clipped, overlapping or placeholder UI, no degraded or non-functional screens?
